title: Quality isnt really good.
text: Quality isnt really good.. I bought these for my step sister and they aren't terrible. I don't like what it is made up. It isn't absorbent. Like if you wash your hands you wouldn't be able to dry them off on it. They look nice and was a good price though. If you are trying to look good in it I' d recommend it, but if you are trying to cook with it, I wouldn't recommend it.
